name: Stock Entry Detail-custom_sales_price
label: Sales Price
description: Unit selling price per STOCK UoM. Auto-filled from the source Material Request line or the default selling Item Price; can be overridden.

name: Material Request-custom_user
label: User
description: User who created this document (shown as the first column on the list view).

name: Stock Entry-custom_user
label: User
description: User who created this document (shown as the first column on the list view).

name: Stock Entry Detail-custom_total_amount_sales_price
label: Total Amount (Sales Price)
description: Sales Price x stock qty for this row (computed).

name: Stock Entry-custom_total_qty
label: Total Qty
description: Sum of the Qty column across all item rows (computed).

name: Stock Entry-custom_total_sales_amount
label: Document Total (Sales Price)
description: Sum of Total Amount (Sales Price) across all item rows (computed).

name: Customer-custom_primary_sales_person
label: Sales Person
description: Primary sales person (first Sales Team row). Auto-synced on Customer save.

name: Customer-custom_outstanding_balance
label: Outstanding Balance
description: SUM of outstanding_amount from submitted Sales Invoices. Updated on each SI/PE submit or cancel.

name: Customer-custom_visit_day
label: Visit Day
description: Weekday (Monday–Saturday) denormalized from the active Journey Plan on submit. Used by the mobile app to resolve today's route.

name: Customer-custom_journey_plan
label: Journey Plan
description: Active Journey Plan covering this customer. Auto-set on Journey Plan submit/cancel.
